formal_title: Representation-Separating Transport, Prospective Policy-Surface Equivalence Challenge, Second Exact Non-Migration Interaction Family, Typed-Interaction↔Generic-Conjunction Divergence, Leave-One-Mechanism-Out Prediction, Frozen Design-Maxim Mapping, Boundary-Preserving Compression Failure & Macro-Law Identifiability Experiment
scientific_target: Force currently tied compact representations to make different fresh predictions and test whether any representation class transports across a second exact non-migration mechanism.

TYPED_INTERACTION.class: Typed conditional policy over semantic coordinates X,G,E
TYPED_INTERACTION.transport_prediction: A semantic coordinate may have different action effects across at least three material geometry states; transport is evaluated by preservation of typed boundaries, not Boolean co-presence alone.

GENERIC_CONJUNCTION.class: Binary low-complexity rule Y = I(X_active) AND I(G_trigger)
GENERIC_CONJUNCTION.transport_prediction: After binarizing X and G according to pre-frozen trigger predicates, all trigger-positive geometries must share the same action; no further geometry-conditioned split is allowed.

UNTYPED_LOOKUP.transport_prediction: No cross-mechanism prediction without new entries; perfect local fit does not count as transport.

representation_separating_condition.preferred_test: Find a fresh family with one semantic X coordinate and at least three pre-frozen material G states where two G states are both generic-conjunction trigger-positive but typed semantics predicts different actions or boundaries.
representation_separating_condition.binary_fallback: A fresh 2x2 may count only as second exact interaction family, not as representation separator.
representation_separating_condition.success_for_typed_over_binary_conjunctio: Observed trigger-positive G states differ in action exactly along a pre-frozen semantic geometry distinction.
representation_separating_condition.success_for_binary_conjunction: All trigger-positive G states collapse to one action and typed extra distinction adds no transport or boundary value.
representation_separating_condition.tie: If both representations remain observationally equivalent on all admitted fresh states, representation identity remains underidentified.

leave_one_mechanism_out.requirement: Fit representation family without one mechanism and predict the held-out mechanism using only frozen semantic mappings.

frozen_named_maxim_mapping.text: When compatibility obligations are active, preserve existing client-observable behavior.
frozen_named_maxim_mapping.prediction: Compatibility-active states should default to preservation independent of surface geometry unless the maxim is explicitly qualified.
frozen_named_maxim_mapping.falsifier: A fresh compatibility-active mechanism lawfully changes behavior on one geometry while preserving another, with the difference supported by source/tests and not by a new post-hoc coordinate.
frozen_named_maxim_mapping.scope: This mapping tests the projection idea generically; it is not a SOLID derivation.

projection_test.question: Does the frozen generic compatibility maxim compress the fresh action surface without losing the boundary?
projection_test.promotion_threshold: At least one fresh exact family plus one held-out transport in which the maxim predicts all admitted actions/boundaries with no ad hoc exception.
projection_test.failure: If preserving the observed boundary requires adding an UNLESS clause after outcome, maxim projection fails for that family.

macro_law_identifiability.strong_macro_law_requires: At least two exact mechanistically distinct families plus a representation class that predicts held-out boundaries better than simpler rivals.
